Variants.Content: The legend of the Green Seer connects dreams, trees, the past and distant visions. Some people regard dreams as divine messages, while others regard them as illness or lies. For those who are truly chased by dreams, the most terrifying thing is not necessarily seeing the future, but not knowing what to believe.
